India Engages with Iran Amidst Supreme Leader's Funeral Preparations

Following the death of Iran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, India has engaged in diplomatic outreach with Tehran. Prime Minister Modi spoke with the Iranian President, and Iran has extended invitations to Indian political figures for the funeral proceedings. These engagements occur amidst international scrutiny of Iran and its regional role.
